title: Mayor's Community Message with Lt. Gilmour
description:
Santa Monica’s strength comes from its community. Our parks, Pier, businesses and public spaces continue to bring residents and visitors together.

The City remains focused on keeping these spaces safe, active and welcoming by supporting a visible public safety presence, working closely with local businesses and community partners, and listening to our residents.

Together, we will continue moving Santa Monica forward.
transcript_text: Hi everyone, Mayor Carolyn Toroses here. [music] Wanted to let you all know that safety is absolutely our top priority. If you've been in and around downtown this week, [music] you've probably noticed increased foot patrols in our Palisades Park area beach, Third Street Promenade, [music] general downtown. For more on that, here's Lieutenant Gilmore. >> Thank you, Mayor. [music] Because the Santa Monica Police Department is at full staffing for the first time in over 20 years, you'll see more of us on foot, on bikes, in vehicles, [music] on the Promenade, on the pier, on the beach, able to respond quickly and effectively for whatever concerns [music] happen in sight of this community. We also want to let the community know that our police officers are highly trained to respond to critical incidents as needed [music] and are actively here in the community with events like this such as Coffee with a Cop. We also have our Community Academy, which gives those in our community an inside look into our police [music] department. And we're always happy to be out. Come say hello. And we're here for our Santa Monica community.
